title: Governing the village
interpretation: Hypothetical leadership and shared work, using an interpretive circa-6000 BCE village. Offices, principles and maintenance scores are gameplay, not excavated institutions.

assets.title: Shared stores
assets.function: Hold the settlement’s single provision reserve, prepare supplies and improve storage.

assets.title: Households and care
assets.function: Maintain inhabited homes, support care and prepare room for newcomers.

assets.title: Cultivation and gathering
assets.function: Allocate seasonal food work across existing cultivated and gathered resources.

assets.title: Landing and waterside work
assets.function: Keep waterside access useful; some food workers illustrate landing-related work.

assets.title: Shared working room
assets.function: Coordinate repair materials and shared handwork learning. Timber gathering supplies the same construction stock.
assets.beneficiaries: Repair crews and households retaining different practices

assets.title: Shared decision space
assets.function: Set standing principles and coordinate access, homes and provisions through existing projects.

assets.title: Watch routes and refuge
assets.function: Prepare routes and support households during the fictional warning. This office is not a standing army.
assets.beneficiaries: Households at home and escorted parties

principles.label: Food reserve objective
principles.body: Gather toward this reserve over two seasons. Two or three seasons put extra gathering at priority 3, before timber (5) and ordinary projects (4–6). One season puts it at priority 7. Lower numbers receive adults first. A higher reserve protects against losses but can delay timber and paid work; limited hands can still cause shortages.

principles.label: Maintenance versus expansion
principles.body: Maintenance first repairs the weakest enabled asset before construction. Expansion first lets projects take those hands. Neglect reduces storage, food output, care or protection below 50 condition.

principles.label: Household support
principles.body: Ordinary care reserves two adults. Shared care uses the existing preparation (6 timber once) and those two care workers; store preparation and learning require separate additional workers.

principles.label: Watch readiness
principles.body: One or two home watch workers, beyond any committed escorts. Ready watch allocates earlier, reducing productive capacity. Safe-route preparation still requires two home workers.

principles.label: Welcoming newcomers
principles.body: Uses the existing spring arrival rule: spare homes, wellbeing, cooperation and two seasons of food for the enlarged population. No arrivals are guaranteed.

principles.label: Shared learning
principles.body: Uses the existing preparation (4 timber once), two dedicated care workers and 4 food of gathering opportunity each active season. Waits during warning and danger. Effective sessions contribute cooperation. The retained household practice score illustrates participation only. It grants no production, civic-readiness or combat bonus; practical wood shaping and watch experience are separate.

ui.adopt: Adopt asset governance for this settlement
ui.migration: This explicit change keeps people, stocks, paid preparations, projects and memories. It retains your manual workforce in the save, then assigns seasonal work automatically. Older campaigns stay manual until you choose this. Active asset saves require version 0.5 or later.
ui.pressure_note: An eight-season authored warning, danger, recovery and renewal. Its end is not a military victory. Begin when you choose. This exercise is separate from optional village warfare and its recurring threats.
ui.god: God oversees both named offices; each decision records its responsible officeholder.
ui.ledger: Provisions {food}/{storage}; reserve objective {target}. Timber {wood}. Adults {adults}; residents {people}/{housing} housing.
ui.forecast: Next season: food {food} ({delta}); gathered {gathered}, eaten {used}, unmet {unfed}, spoilage {spoil}, pressure losses {losses}, overflow {overflow}. Timber gathering {wood}; repair cost {repair}.
ui.actual: Last season: provisions {food}; unmet {unfed}; construction {work} work points. Inspect the journal and household memory for the consequences.
ui.labor: Other work took the available adults; reduce higher priorities or crew budgets.
ui.phase: Learning waits for recovery; its workers stay available for other duties.
ui.idle: No active construction; adults return to food work.
ui.allocation_order: Committed carriers and escorts first; essential food, household care, then ranked requests. Lower priority numbers go first; ties use stable request IDs. Remaining adults gather food. Adults rotate by stable citizen ID and season; children never work.
ui.project: {title}: {progress}/{work} work; {wood} timber committed once; next work {next}.
ui.cancel: Cancel and return unused timber share
ui.paused: Paused; progress and invested material retained
ui.refund: Cancellation refund now: {wood} timber. Completed work has no refund.
ui.paid: Prepared: {paid}; effective next season: {ready}; dedicated workers {filled}/{needed}; timber to enable {wood}.
ui.growth: Growth readiness uses the current Town support requirements: {people}/{required} residents, {homes}/{dwellings} dwellings, {food}/{reserve} provisions, wellbeing {wellbeing}/{wellbeing_required}, cooperation {cooperation}/{cooperation_required}, protection {security}/{security_required}. Sustained {stable}/{seasons} seasons.
ui.group_body: Coordinate the existing cultivation → north access → north/east housing projects. Materials commit only when each eligible step is commissioned. No second construction ledger. Completion also needs provisions for additional households. Pause or cancel stops further commissions; existing projects remain individually controllable.
ui.group_wait: Build the current step, gather timber, free a queue slot or restore provisions before commissioning another.
ui.tutorial_complete: Governance guide complete. Continue balancing reserves, repairs, learning, protection and supported growth. Current Town support is separate from earned civic achievement.
ui.people: Residents are inspectable participants. Work follows assets and offices; selecting a resident gives no civilian orders.
ui.manual: This settlement uses its retained manual workforce. Adopt asset governance explicitly to change allocation.
ui.no_report: Resolve a season to record actual results.

errors.asset_managed: Work is allocated through assets and principles in this mode.
errors.asset_pressure: The warning chapter has already begun.
errors.asset_growth: Housing coordination is not active or the next step is blocked.
errors.asset_supplies: Keep at least one season of provisions before committing another housing step.
errors.asset_review: Complete the practical step before reviewing it.

ui.food_upkeep: Food forgone through neglected fields and landing: {food}; workroom yield penalty per builder: {work}.

tutorial.title: 1 · Understand the shared store
tutorial.body: Inspect its provisions and reserve objective. A reserve target allocates effort; it does not create food. Use the asset list or click its building.

tutorial.title: 2 · Choose standing principles
tutorial.body: Change a principle in Principles. Review what it protects and which work may wait; no particular setting is required.

tutorial.title: 3 · Commission work through an asset
tutorial.body: Commission an affordable project. Cultivation is a useful first choice. If blocked, inspect its prerequisite, timber or authority; gather for a season if necessary.

tutorial.title: 4 · Let the settlement assign people
tutorial.body: Read allocated/requested work below. Compare care, watch, materials and construction with food needs. Citizen inspection explains activities and never issues an errand.

tutorial.title: 5 · Compare forecast and results
tutorial.body: Resolve a season, then compare its actual report with your forecast. Paused or unfilled initiatives retain progress and consume no new construction material.

tutorial.title: 6 · Reconsider priorities under pressure
tutorial.body: Begin the optional warning when ready, then change a principle, project priority or crew budget. Ready watch and stores can help; resolve seasons to observe costs and delayed work.

tutorial.title: 7 · Support recovery and learning
tutorial.body: From recovery onward, prepare learning and leave room for its two dedicated workers and gathering cost. Reduce project crews or reserve ambition if it waits. Resolve a learning season.

tutorial.title: 8 · Prepare supported growth
tutorial.body: Coordinate cultivation, north access and the two existing homes. Keep two seasons of provisions for the enlarged population, then review town readiness. Welcoming remains your choice; no automatic upgrade follows.
